BiblicalUsage: The Aramaic word for knocking is heard once, and it is a terrible sound: Belshazzar's knees knocking together when the fingers write on the wall. His whole body gives him away before his mind has understood a word of it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the body often knows before the mind does — guilt and fear make the knees speak the truth.
